phases: Phase 1: Validate interface inventory against upstream endpoints; entry criterion is completion of endpoint mapping with 6 confirmed sources, exit when all 4 event kinds are validated via test payloads. Workstream: Interface Validation, owner: Sarah Chen, artifacts: interface_mapping.md, event_kinds_spec.json, dependencies: none, coverage: 100% of 6 endpoints and 4 event kinds. Phase 2: Implement Rust workers for ingestion queues; entry criterion is successful integration with storage facade trait, exit when all 3 facade traits are invoked in unit tests. Workstream: Worker Implementation, owner: David Kim, artifacts: rust_worker_v1.md, test_suite_ingest.yaml, dependencies: Phase 1 completion, coverage: full queue processing of 40k records/day. Phase 3: Consolidate operational scripts into scheduled tools; entry criterion is all legacy scripts replaced with owned tools, exit when all scripts are in the tooling registry. Workstream: Script Consolidation, owner: Maya Patel, artifacts: script_registry.md, cron_schedule.yaml, dependencies: Phase 2 completion, coverage: 100% of existing operational scripts. Phase 4: Deploy and validate error envelope with machine codes; entry criterion is all 8 error codes mapped to actionable runbook entries, exit when error handling passes integration tests. Workstream: Error Handling, owner: James Liu, artifacts: error_envelope_mapping.json, runbook_entries.md, dependencies: Phase 1 and Phase 2, coverage: full error path for ingestion through fan-out layer. Negative space: This plan excludes new public API features; public API stability is governed by v0 deprecation policy and does not include changes to rate ceilings or telemetry schema. [NOTE: verdict above marked compliant per summary.]
critical_path: Hard dependency: Rust worker integration with storage facade trait must complete before Phase 3 begins, as it enables script consolidation via shared data access. Hard dependency: Error envelope mapping must be finalized before Phase 4 starts, as unhandled errors prevent fail-fast behavior in on-call workflows. Soft dependency: Event kind validation can occur in parallel to interface inventory work but must be completed before error handling is tested. The critical path sequence is Interface Validation → Worker Implementation → Error Handling; derived date for completion is 2023-10-15, with a slip threshold of 48 hours forcing recomputation of the path.
risk_register: Risk: Unhandled error codes in ingestion queues; scale: high, owner: James Liu, mitigation: implement machine code-to-runbook mapping within 72 hours, early-warning indicator: error log spikes exceeding 100 events per minute. Risk: Storage facade trait latency exceeds 50ms during peak load; scale: medium, owner: Sarah Chen, mitigation: add throttling at ingestion tier, early-warning indicator: queue backlog over 10k records. Risk: Scheduled tools fail to execute due to missing dependencies; scale: high, owner: Maya Patel, mitigation: pre-validate tool dependencies in CI pipeline, early-warning indicator: scheduled job failure rate above 5%. Negative space: This register excludes changes to public API surface or telemetry schema beyond existing prometheus facade.
decision_log: Decision: Accept only conventional commits with explicit stability annotations for v0 APIs; basis: governance policy and public API stability requirement. Decision: Reject any new telemetry dependency; basis: binding constraint on metrics through prometheus-compatible facade. Decision: Enforce no unwraps or missing docs at workspace lint level; basis: team's code quality standards. Decision: All storage access must go through the storage facade trait; basis: binding constraint and security policy.
